messages:
tanya: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 to fix two broken anchors and add a small JS SDK streaming example. Hoping to land before Friday's deploy window.

sam: I can review now. Is this blocked on preview?

linkchecker: running link check for PR #4521...

eli: FYI we've had a midday reviewer gap earlier this week. For single-anchor or typo fixes, should we allow self-merge if: (1) local link-check passes, (2) at least one approval is recorded, and (3) a short note is added to the merge commit?

tanya: That would help. I've run `npm run docs:link-check` locally (clean). Snippet below: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
for await (const chunk of await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw-small', messages })) process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
```

sam: quick nit: expand the snippet into a named async fn for clarity, otherwise lgtm. Approving now.

docs-preview-bot: preview build queued for PR #4521 (status: running)

linkchecker: link check complete: 0 broken links (local run).

tanya: approved by @sam, local link-check done. If preview flakes, can I self-merge under the suggested fallback?

eli: +1 from me for the fallback as long as we record the check and approval in the PR. We'll add the policy to docs/reviewer-ops.md.

docs-preview-bot: preview build succeeded for PR #4521 (status: success).

tanya: merged to main at 3333333698. Filing issue to formalize the midday fallback: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/476

sam: thanks. small follow-up: add a checkbox in PR template "local link-check run" so we can surface it via bots.

tanya: will do in a follow-up. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
